name: unsafe fn deallocate (& mut self , elem_layout : Layout)
rule: After `deallocate` returns, the `RawVecInner` instance must not be used again: its owned allocation has been deallocated, but its `ptr` and `cap` remain unchanged, so subsequent use must not cause double-free or use-after-free.
